hero.title:
Live interpretation,
made effortless
hero.subtitle:
One meeting link, one mic button.
Everything else is handled automatically.
hero.trialNote: Try 500 translated characters without signing in. Sign up and get 30 free minutes every month.

captionDemo.title:
Mixed languages in,
one language out
captionDemo.body: Korean, English and Japanese are detected per utterance and streamed straight into captions. Turn on the AI interpreter voice and it sounds like an interpreter sitting next to you.

demo.autoDetectNote: Korean, English and Japanese mixed — each utterance is detected automatically. This is exactly how the product works.

zoom.title: For Zoom calls, the interpreter bot joins for you
zoom.body: Paste a meeting link and the bot joins, interprets the conversation in real time, and posts a caption link into the chat that anyone can open. Nothing to install, nothing to configure.
zoom.point1: Works with Zoom · Teams · Meet · Webex
zoom.point2: Live captions and voice matched to each participant's language
zoom.point3: A side-by-side transcript remains after the meeting

autoDetect.title: Automatic language detection
autoDetect.body: Even meetings mixing three languages are detected per utterance. You only pick the display language.

voiceOut.title: Captions and voice, together
voiceOut.body: Captions stream instantly, and an AI voice can read them aloud like a live interpreter.

records.title: Records, automatically
records.body: A side-by-side transcript remains when you finish. There is no record button to remember.

finalCta.title: Just turn on your mic
finalCta.body: Try it without signing in. 500 characters is all it takes.

login.title: Get started
login.subtitle: Start in 3 seconds with your Google account. No separate sign-up flow.

progress.signingIn: Signing in with your Google account
progress.hint: Please wait a moment — don't close this window.

login.freeNote: 20 free minutes every month. No card required.

failed.title: Sign-in failed
failed.action: Allow popups for this site or try again in a moment.

try.banner: Trial mode — experience the real interpretation quality for 500 translated characters, no sign-in needed.

ended.title: That's the end of the trial
ended.body: What you just saw is the real performance. Sign up for 30 free minutes every month.
ended.freeNote: Starts instantly with your Google account — no card required.

faceoffEntry.tokenNotice: Face-off runs two interpretation sessions at once and uses 2 tokens per minute (10 min = 20 tokens)

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Pay for what you use. Counted in tokens, not time — one balance for every mode.
pricing.yearlyHint: Pay yearly and save 10% (over 2 months free)
pricing.freeNote: Every paid plan comes after a free 20 tokens/month tier. Prices exclude VAT.
pricing.meetingMode: Meeting interpreter bot (Zoom · Teams · Meet · Webex)
pricing.noOverage: No overage billing — we notify you when tokens run out

tokenStd.title: Token standard
tokenStd.subtitle: 1 token = 1 minute of general mode. Each mode burns at its own rate.

pro.name: Pro
pro.for: Individuals and freelancers who interpret weekly

business.name: Business
business.for: Companies where the whole team joins

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.pgNote: Payments activate once our payment provider review completes. Apply now to reserve your spot — we'll email you the moment it opens.

reserved.title: Your request is in
reserved.body: We'll email you as soon as payments open. Your free 30 minutes a month keep working in the meantime.

company.title: Company info (Business)
company.name: Company name
company.note: Teammates join from [Settings → Join company] by searching your company name and entering the code issued below. Tokens are shared from the company wallet.
company.codeHint: Share this code with your team. You can regenerate or edit it anytime in Settings.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your account and company (team) usage.

companyJoin.title: Join a company
companyJoin.hint: Type at least 2 characters to search, pick your company, then enter the join code. Once joined, usage is billed to the company wallet.
companyJoin.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in about {min} min.

companyManage.title: {name} · Company admin
companyManage.regenHint: Regenerating invalidates the previous code immediately.

tokens.asMinutes: General {general} min · Meeting {meeting} min · Face-off {faceoff} min
tokens.debtHint: New sessions stay locked until this is settled.
tokens.pgPending: Request received — payment integration coming soon.
tokens.packNote: Top-up tokens never expire and are used after your plan's included tokens.

chart.title: Daily usage
chart.empty: Start interpreting and daily usage piles up here.

startTalk.subtitle: Hold to speak, like a radio

recent.title: Recent sessions

startFaceoff.title: Face-to-face
startFaceoff.subtitle: Sit across, each in their tongue

setup.langPairHint: Pick what you read and what they hear.

running.enableSound: Tap here to turn on the interpreter voice

ended.savedNote: The transcript is saved and the AI summary is being written.

micPermission.action: Allow the microphone in your browser's site permissions, then try again.

startFailed.action: Check your network and try again. If it keeps failing, check the server log for the error message.

keyMissing.action: Put OPENAI_API_KEY into apps/web/.env.local and restart the dev server.

connectionLost.title: Lost connection to the translation engine
connectionLost.action: The session was ended. Check your network and start again.

unsupportedPair.title: This language pair is not supported yet

guestQuota.action: Sign up for 30 free minutes every month, then continue where you left off.

quotaExhausted.action: The free plan refills every month. Upgrade your plan or top up tokens to keep going right now.

debtUnpaid.action: Settle the outstanding amount from the dashboard and you can start again right away.

authRequired.title: Sign-in required

meeting.title: Meeting interpreting
meeting.subtitle:
Paste a meeting link and the bot joins the call,
then posts a caption link into the chat.

botRow.title: Bot joins and posts the link
botRow.body: Once the bot joins, it posts the live caption link into the meeting chat.

meeting.urlInvalid: Check the meeting link. Zoom, Teams, Meet and Webex addresses are supported.
meeting.sourceHint: Detected automatically even when participants mix languages.
meeting.consentNotice: When the bot joins, an interpretation notice is posted in the meeting chat.

unavailable.title: Meeting mode opens in Phase 4
unavailable.body: The structure (bot join → server relay → caption link) is in place. Once RECALL_API_KEY and the Realtime Worker are connected, this screen goes live.

live.title: The bot has joined the meeting
live.hint: The caption link is also posted in the meeting chat. Participants open it without signing in.

failed.title: Could not send the bot
failed.bot_create_failed: The meeting bot was rejected. Check the meeting URL and waiting-room settings.

translateText.title: Text translation
translateText.lead: Paste and it translates. No button to press.
translateText.placeholder: Type or paste what you want translated.

keyMissing.title: Translation engine key is not configured

failed.action: Try again in a moment. If it keeps failing, split the text into smaller parts.

quota.title: You've used all your free characters this month
quota.action: Sign up and your monthly free allowance resets.

tooLong.title: This text is longer than your remaining free characters
tooLong.action: Shorten it, or sign up and continue.

translateFile.title: File translation
translateFile.lead: Drop a PDF or image and get it side by side with the original.
translateFile.dropHint: PDF or image, up to {mb}MB. Files are never stored on our server.
translateFile.printHint: Use this window's Print (Ctrl+P) and choose "Save as PDF". The print dialog opens shortly.

unsupported.title: Unsupported file type
unsupported.action: Upload a PDF or a PNG, JPG or WEBP image.

noTextLayer.title: This PDF has no text layer
noTextLayer.action: It looks scanned. Export the pages as images and upload those — we read the text from the picture.

authRequired.title: Sign-in required
authRequired.action: File translation is available after signing in.

keyMissing.title: Translation engine key is not configured

failed.title: Could not translate
failed.action: Try again in a moment. If the document is long, split it into parts.

translateFile.recentNote: Stored in this browser only. Your file is never uploaded.
translateFile.scanning: No text layer — reading the pages as images…
translateFile.ocrNote: This document had no text layer, so the original was read from images. It may contain OCR errors.
translateFile.docxLead: Formatting stays untouched — only the text changes. Tables, headers, footers, bullets and images all survive.
translateFile.docxReplaceHint: Replaces the original text with the translation.
translateFile.docxBilingualHint: Adds the translation under each original paragraph.
translateFile.docxDoneBilingual: Side-by-side downloaded. Translations added to {translated} paragraphs.
translateFile.docxMissing: {missing} paragraphs kept their original text — no translation came back.

sessions.emptyHint: Start interpreting and the transcript plus an AI summary are saved automatically.
